source_refs.note: C. Reduction involving –COOH group: a main subheading of 23.5 Reactions of Carboxylic Acids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 110-110.

blocks.text: The powerful reducing agent lithium tetrahydridoaluminate (III) reduces carboxylic acids to primary alcohols.

blocks.title: Reduction
blocks.text:
i. Gain of H₂ (or H⁻)
ii. Loss of O or O₂
iii. Loss of X₂ (Halogens)
iv. Gain of electrons
v. Decrease in Ox state.
Other common reducing agents H₂/Ni and sodium tetrahydridoborate (III) will not reduce carboxylic acids.
